title: Rissanen Data Analysis: Examining Dataset Characteristics via Description Length

bias_targets.methodology: Masking male-gendered and female-gendered words in text datasets and comparing their impact on the dataset's Minimum Description Length (MDL). The method evaluates whether words associated with one gender are disproportionately more useful for compressing dataset labels than the other.

Evaluating the Minimum Description Length (MDL) of the dataset labels when providing only the input text length (number of tokens), to determine if length alone is highly predictive of the class label.
